quoted_text: 19102.B: The unit of trading shall be U.S. Treasury Notes having a face value at maturity of one hundred thousand dollars ($100,000)
19102.C: Par shall be on the basis of 100 points, with each point equal to $1,000 per contract.
Minimum Price Fluctuation Outright: 1/2 of 1/32 of one point (0.015625) = $15.625
19102.C: The minimum price fluctuation shall be one-half of one thirty-second of one point (equal to $15.625 per contract)
Listed Contracts: Quarterly contracts (Mar, Jun, Sep, Dec) listed for 3 consecutive quarters

unit: business days before last business day of contract month
quoted_text: Termination Of Trading: Trading terminates at 12:01 p.m. on the 7th business day prior to the last business day of the contract month.

unit: first business day of contract month
quoted_text: 19104: Deliveries against an expiring contract can be made no earlier than the first business day of the contract's named month of expiration

19104.A: No later than 6:00 p.m. on the second business day preceding the intended day of delivery, the short Clearing Member must tender to the Clearing House all notices of intention to make delivery
